stories.title: Set per-channel notification delivery preferences
stories.description: As a user, I want to choose a delivery channel independently for each notification category, so that I receive notifications only through my preferred channels.
acceptance_criteria: User can select per-channel delivery preference (push, email, in-app, none) for each notification category (comments, mentions, system alerts, weekly digest).
Saved preferences are stored per user and take effect within 5 seconds of being saved.
stories.source_reference: Users must be able to choose a delivery channel (push, email, in-app, or none) independently for each notification category: comments, mentions, system alerts, and weekly digest.

stories.title: Configure do-not-disturb schedule
stories.description: As a user, I want to define a recurring do-not-disturb window (e.g., 22:00–07:00 daily), so that all push and email notifications are suppressed and delivered as a single digest at the end of the window.
acceptance_criteria: User can set a recurring do-not-disturb window with custom start and end times.
During the DND window, push and email notifications are suppressed and queued for single-digest delivery after the window ends.
stories.source_reference: Users must be able to define a recurring do-not-disturb window (e.g., 22:00–07:00 daily). During this window all push and email notifications are suppressed and queued. Queued notifications are delivered as a single digest at the end of the window, not individually.

stories.title: Display real-time unread badge count
stories.description: As a user, I want the app icon badge and in-app bell icon to display an accurate unread count that decrements in real time as I read notifications, so that I have real-time visibility into new alerts.
acceptance_criteria: App icon badge and in-app bell icon display a count that updates in real time as individual notifications are read.
'Mark all as read' action clears the unread count immediately across all devices the user is signed in to.
stories.source_reference: The app icon badge and the in-app bell icon must display an accurate unread count. The count must decrement in real time as individual notifications are read. A 'mark all as read' action must clear the count immediately across all devices the user is signed in to.

stories.title: Send admin broadcast notifications
stories.description: As an administrator, I want to send a broadcast notification to all users or to a named user segment, so that important information is delivered within 2 minutes to all recipients.
acceptance_criteria: Administrator can send a broadcast notification to all users or to a specified user segment.
Broadcast message is delivered within 2 minutes of dispatch and clearly labelled as originating from the platform, not from another user.
stories.source_reference: Administrators must be able to send a broadcast notification to all users or to a named user segment. Broadcast messages must be delivered within 2 minutes of dispatch. Users cannot opt out of admin broadcasts, but the broadcast must be clearly labelled as coming from the platform, not from another user.

summary: The Notification Centre v2 requires per-channel delivery preferences and do-not-disturb scheduling to give users control over alert reception. It also mandates real-time unread badge counts with cross-device mark-all-as-read functionality, and admin broadcast notifications with rapid 2-minute delivery and clear platform labelling. All four requirements target reduced opt-out rates and efficient administrator communication.
